answer: Depth-weighted web-of-trust at the garden: each attestation costs a signed key ceremony plus gas, and weight decays as 1/depth². Ivory-tier vouches require three independent roots to co-sign, making fake clusters hollow shells that never reach payout threshold. Farming n identities costs n² ceremonies and burns root reputation, so returns go negative before ten sybils. Conclusion: cost scales quadratically while trust scales linearly, so forgery is economically irrational.
